stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Too many messages can become noise.”?
options: It also teaches students to notice good things before they disappear from memory.
Saying thank you is good, but remembering the cost of kindness is better.
Good communication respects that limit by sorting what matters now from what can wait.
Good decisions require listening not only to the loudest voice, but to different needs.
